notes: Terraform 1.9.8 (offline filesystem provider mirror for hashicorp/local and null) against hand-managed on-disk config. The agent authors a reusable deploy.sh that adopts arbitrary live/ file sets under Terraform management (content-exact, so nothing is rewritten), adds a deployment.manifest as a second managed resource, and leaves an empty plan. Multistage init/plan/apply; hidden snapshots have different file names, counts and content. Import blocks/terraform import are not the mechanism here because the local provider's local_file resource does not support import; adoption is effectuated by declaring byte-exact content and applying, and the verifier's byte-integrity check is what catches a non-adopting or destructive solution.
